changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Restore canonical modeling menus that were hidden before the controlled-retirement observation gate completed. Existing menu ids and portal_menu_visibility bindings remain unchanged.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = FALSE, last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-restore', last_modified_date = now() WHERE name IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.warehousePlans', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticObjects', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticModels', 'sys.nav.portal.studioMetricWorkbench', 'sys.nav.portal.dataMetrics' ) AND deleted = TRUE AND last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-convergence';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = TRUE, last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-convergence', last_modified_date = now() WHERE name IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.warehousePlans', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticObjects', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticModels', 'sys.nav.portal.studioMetricWorkbench', 'sys.nav.portal.dataMetrics' ) AND deleted = FALSE AND last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-restore';
